## This week

The loop, owned: last week it ran invisibly inside the client; this week it is built by hand — Call, Judge, Execute, Reinject, with an explicit bound. The measured failure of an Act-only protocol, the ReAct convention (a written Thought before every action, grounding), why today's tool-calling models carry that convention in their weights, and trace reading as the basic debugging procedure.
